description: Curated, stable source candidates for historical/cultural review. A candidate is an evidence lead, not an approval of the matching game line.

policy.approval_rule: A reviewer must check the exact claim, period, place and wording against the source before changing a queue row to reviewed.
policy.no_external_source_rule: Fictional UI, divination output and connective prose are marked no_external_source rather than being given a misleading historical citation.
